correctness.rationale: Four-chart exact Jacobian-ideal Gröbner tests cover all 511 nonzero sections, yielding 144 smooth curves. A separate GF16 evaluation and explicit generators of the 72-element ambient group recover all six complete orbits and their nine-rational-point incidence. The global order conclusion additionally proves each ruling involution is a reflection of a rational degree-two divisor class, so the composite translates by an F2-point; permutation order on C(F2) exactly equals geometric automorphism order. Thus finite orbit checking is exhaustive and is not an unsupported infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The field F2 is the first/wild characteristic-two case of embedded genus-one biquadratics; classifying its two degree-two maps by branch splitting and their composite translation order is a natural arithmetic-geometric problem. The six-orbit census is complete, separates equal point-count curves with different global periods, and shows a unique order-five class with two wild single-branch projections. It is not a mere generic period-five example or a point-count-only recomputation. Exact small-field embedding strata can serve as structural base cases for characteristic-two QRT and finite-field elliptic-curve studies.
